text:
toni: opened PR to normalize Tempest model aliases in the catalog + fix a broken sample link in the Tempest-embed section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6021. Need quick review: wording, bench table, and SDK v4 snippets.

harpreet: quick callout  some customers pinned the old alias `tempest-lite` which now maps to `tempest-lite-v1` and the pin broke. we should add a small migration note and an infra grep snippet to help SEs find old pins.

lucas: bench numbers I ran (single A100, batch=8, synthetic 768-dim): embed qps medians:
- tempest-nonquant: 520 qps
- tempest-lite-v1: 340 qps
- tempest-4bit-adapter: 380 qps
latency medians (ms):  
- nonquant: 12ms
- lite-v1: 22ms
- 4bit-adapter: 18ms
CSV uploaded to internal bench bucket: /benchmarks/embeddings/tempest-variants.csv

emily: nit: sample link under /docs/models/tempest/embed-example currently points to /benchmarks/tempest which was renamed. update to /benchmarks/embeddings/tempest-variants.csv. also the cURL example used `tempest-lite` (old alias)  please update to `tempest-lite-v1` in both the code block and the note.

toni: good catches. I'll update the PR to change the cURL and add an explicit migration script snippet: a sed one-liner to replace old aliases in infra configs. e.g.:
```bash
# replace old model alias in terraform /yaml configs
sed -i "s/tempest-lite/tempest-lite-v1/g" $(git grep -l "tempest-lite")
```

harpreet: suggest also adding a short compat note under "Model variants": "4-bit adapter variants disable kernel-level streaming fusions on small GPUs; for low tail-latency embed pipelines prefer non-quant or run with batch_size >= 8." Keep it short.

lucas: added a tiny two-row table in the PR: recommended default -> tradeoff: `tempest-nonquant` (best latency), `tempest-lite-v1` (balanced), `tempest-4bit-adapter` (best memory). I pasted the CSV summary.

emily: SDK v4 snippet: remember `batch_size` param for embeddings helper. proposed snippet (js):
```js
const emb = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: "tempest-lite-v1",
  input: texts,
  batch_size: 8,
});
```

toni: pushed updates: fixed links, added the sed migration tip, updated the SDK snippet to v4, and added compatibility sentence. preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/6021/

docbot: docs-lint: failed \uD83D\uDC5A - bench CSV link points to internal path; please use the canonical bench URL /benchmarks/embeddings/tempest-variants.csv (relative) or public bucket.

toni: fixed the link to /benchmarks/embeddings/tempest-variants.csv and swapped the CSV to the public bench bucket. pushed new commit.

lucas: reviewed, left one formatting nit in the table header. also recommend a one-liner in Migration: how Dedicated customers can pin old alias temporarily via the variants API: small curl example.

emily: curl example for pinning (added to PR):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/variants \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"tempest","variant":"tempest-lite-v1"}'
```

harpreet: left +1, agree with migration curl. can we also add a short FAQ entry: "How to detect if a pin broke" -> check `client.variants.list()` or search infra. Keeping that will help SEs.

toni: added FAQ and a short repro script for SEs to run a quick embed qps check (python) and referenced the bench CSV. pushed final commit. preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/6021/ (staging)

docbot: docs-lint: passed \u2705 preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/6021/ (staging)

lucas: +1

emily: +1 (left one tiny nit about escaping in the sed example but not blocking)

harpreet: merging after CI. follow-up created to scan infra repos for `tempest-lite` references and open a tidy PR for customers we know are pinned.

toni: thanks all :tada:
